evidence_slice: Dartmoor National Park Authority adopted the Dartmoor Local Plan 2018-2036 on 3 December 2021. Proposal 7.6(3), Land at Timbers Road, Buckfastleigh, allocates Parcel A for around 70 homes, with not less than 45% affordable housing to meet identified local needs, and Parcel B for highway improvements to access Plymouth Road. The Authority-hosted DCC_Land_Charges_Local_Plan FeatureServer layer 7 is named Site Allocations: Housing Development, has polygon geometry in EPSG:27700, exposes site_name, polcy_ref, settlement, site_area and policy_type fields, and reports data last edited 12 June 2026.

field_evidence.allocation_status: new allocation in Dartmoor Local Plan 2018-2036
field_evidence.parcel_b_use: highway improvement works to access Plymouth Road

binding_method: authority-hosted structured polygon FeatureServer layer plus adopted Local Plan exact allocation; exact feature extraction and canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
